metrics.title: Daily active installs
metrics.purpose: How many installs open an app on a day.
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people; one person on two devices counts twice. A week or month reads as the average day.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.active' AND dim = 'day' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app

metrics.title: Weekly active installs
metrics.purpose: How many installs open an app in an ISO week.
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. Each install reports once per week, so a week still running is a partial count.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.active' AND dim = 'week' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: Monthly active installs
metrics.purpose: How many installs open an app in a calendar month.
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. A month still running is a partial count.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(day, 'start of month') AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'app.active' AND dim = 'month' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: New installs
metrics.purpose: Installs active in the week they were installed, the closest Lifestream gets to downloads that open the app.
metrics.caveat: Only installs that ran a version with Lifestream and left usage counts on. App Store downloads are the downloads metric.

metrics.title: Week-1 retention
metrics.purpose: The share of a week's new installs that are active again the next week.
metrics.caveat: The period is the install week. A cohort under 5 installs is hidden, and the latest cohort has no week 1 yet.

metrics.title: Week-4 retention
metrics.purpose: The share of a week's new installs still active four weeks later.
metrics.caveat: The period is the install week. A cohort under 5 installs is hidden, and cohorts younger than four weeks have no value.

metrics.title: Paywall views
metrics.purpose: How often a paywall is seen, by placement.
metrics.caveat: Each install counts once per day per placement.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'paywall.view' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Checkouts
metrics.purpose: What happened when a paywall's buy button was pressed, by outcome.
metrics.caveat: The outcome is the app's view of the purchase; the ledger's purchases are the record of what Apple charged.
metrics.sql:
SELECT day AS period, app,
  CASE WHEN instr(dim, '|') > 0 THEN substr(dim, 1, instr(dim, '|') - 1) ELSE dim END AS dim,
  SUM(count) AS value FROM daily
WHERE event = 'paywall.checkout' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, 3

metrics.title: Paywall purchases
metrics.purpose: Checkouts that ended in a purchase.
metrics.caveat: The app's view of the purchase.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, '' AS dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'paywall.checkout' AND (dim = 'purchased' OR dim LIKE 'purchased|%') AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app

metrics.title: Paywall conversion
metrics.purpose: Purchases per paywall view.
metrics.caveat: Views are once per install per day per placement, so this is purchases per paywall day rather than per showing.

metrics.title: First-run steps
metrics.purpose: How many installs reach each first-run step, once per install.
metrics.caveat: Each install reports a step once in its life, on the day it first reaches it.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'funnel.step' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Portal impressions
metrics.purpose: How often the cross-promotion portal or a contextual overlay shows another Midgar app, by target app and placement.
metrics.caveat: Counts showings, not installs.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event IN ('impression', 'overlay') AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Portal taps
metrics.purpose: Taps on another Midgar app in the portal, by target app and placement.
metrics.caveat: A tap opens the App Store page; the install, if any, is the downloads metric's campaign.
metrics.sql: SELECT day AS period, app, dim, SUM(count) AS value FROM daily WHERE event = 'tap' AND day BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY day, app, dim

metrics.title: Sales
metrics.purpose: App Store sale events as Apple notifies them, by kind.
metrics.caveat: Production only. Kinds are INITIAL_PURCHASE, RENEWAL, NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE, REFUND and REVOCATION as the ledger maps them.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(event_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS period, slug AS app, kind AS dim, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sale_events WHERE environment = 'Production' AND date(event_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

metrics.title: Refunds
metrics.purpose: Purchases Apple refunded or revoked.
metrics.caveat: Production only; the day Apple told the ledger, not the day of the purchase.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(event_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS period, slug AS app, '' AS dim, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sale_events WHERE environment = 'Production' AND kind IN ('REFUND', 'REVOCATION') AND date(event_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: Active subscriptions
metrics.purpose: Subscriptions paid up at the end of each day.
metrics.caveat: Production only, counted from the transactions the ledger has; a subscription bought before the ledger existed counts from its first renewal the ledger saw.
metrics.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS (SELECT :since UNION ALL SELECT date(d, '+1 day') FROM days WHERE d < :until) SELECT d AS period, t.slug AS app, '' AS dim, COUNT(DISTINCT t.original_transaction_id) AS value FROM days JOIN transactions t
  ON t.environment = 'Production' AND t.type = 'Auto-Renewable Subscription' AND t.revocation_date IS NULL
  AND t.purchase_date < (unixepoch(d, '+1 day') * 1000) AND t.expires_date >= (unixepoch(d, '+1 day') * 1000)
GROUP BY d, t.slug

metrics.title: Introductory offers started
metrics.purpose: Subscriptions that started on an introductory offer, a free trial in most apps.
metrics.caveat: Production only. Apple's offer type 1 covers free trials and pay-up-front or pay-as-you-go introductory prices alike.
metrics.sql:
SELECT date(purchase_date / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS period, slug AS app, '' AS dim, COUNT(DISTINCT original_transaction_id) AS value FROM transactions WHERE environment = 'Production' AND type = 'Auto-Renewable Subscription' AND offer_type = 1
  AND transaction_id = original_transaction_id AND date(purchase_date / 1000, 'unixepoch') BETWEEN :since AND :until
GROUP BY period, app

metrics.title: AI requests
metrics.purpose: Chat requests mako served, by model alias.
metrics.caveat: Chat requests only; image generations are not counted here.
metrics.sql: SELECT date(c.created_at) AS period, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.registry_slug, ''), c.app_id) AS app, c.alias AS dim, COUNT(*) AS value FROM chat_requests c LEFT JOIN apps a ON a.app_id = c.app_id WHERE date(c.created_at) BETWEEN :since AND :until GROUP BY period, app, dim

metrics.title: Downloads
metrics.purpose: First-time App Store downloads, from Apple's sales reports.
metrics.caveat: Apple's reports arrive a day or two late. Read on the machine that has the myyty warehouse.

metrics.title: Proceeds
metrics.purpose: What Apple pays out after its commission, from Apple's sales reports.
metrics.caveat: Euro proceeds only; myyty keeps every currency apart and never converts, so other currencies are named beside the answer. Apple's reports arrive a day or two late. Read on the machine that has the myyty warehouse.
